---
title: "How to submit"
---

You hand in every assignment through the submission form of your module. You need to be signed in with a Google account to upload files.

| Module | Submission form |
|---|---|
| SKI3010 | *link follows* |
| SKI3011 | *link follows* |
| PRO3017 | *link follows* |

## Checklist

* **One submission per group** for group assignments; the peer review is individual.
* **File names:** `MODULE_Assignment_Surnames`, for example `SKI3010_A1b_Jansen_Peeters.docx`.
* **Formats:** text as .docx or .pdf, R code as .R, data as .csv.
* **SKI3011 and PRO3017:** always include your R script and your dataset, so that your results can be reproduced.
* **Deadlines** are in Maastricht time. See [Deadlines](deadlines.qmd) or subscribe to the calendar.
